fix_1_modal_scroll.problem: Product modal image locked/sticky while details scrolled, clipping content like waterproof badge, description, metal switcher, and ring size picker with unsightly scrollbars.
fix_1_modal_scroll.solution: Single Unified Scroll Container with overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scrollbar-width: none;. On mobile screens, set image max-height to 240px-260px (aspect ratio 1/1 centered). Fixed bottom action dock with position: sticky; bottom: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding-bottom: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 8px)); z-index: 10.

fix_2_bottom_nav_overlap.problem: Fixed bottom navigation bar cutting off category circles, catalog grid bottom items, and footer links.
fix_2_bottom_nav_overlap.solution: Apply main, .page-wrapper padding-bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px)) !important. Render bottom bar as a floating 64px glass pill dock (backdrop-filter: blur(24px), background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)) with active scale(0.92) tactile feedback.

fix_3_compact_hero.problem: Massive 3-column stats and giant arch frame pushing catalog far below the fold.
fix_3_compact_hero.solution: Compact periwinkle gradient banner (#E8F2FC to #F4F8FD), headline "Timeless Beauty, Crafted for You.", 13px muted subtitle, floating jewel with subtle sparkle animation, and instant "Explore Catalog ↓" smooth scroll CTA.

fix_4_interactive_selectors.metal_selector: Horizontal row of pill buttons with color swatches: 18K Yellow Gold (#D4AF37), Platinum / White Gold (#CBD5E1), 18K Rose Gold (#E0A99A) with active state bold border and dynamic payload updates.
fix_4_interactive_selectors.ring_size_selector: Compact numerical pills ([6] [7] [8] [9] [10]) with Size Guide link opening millimeter finger measurement modal.

zero_api_whatsapp_engine.single_item_flow: Generates direct purchase URI with product name, SKU, metal finish, size, price/MRP, free shipping note, and concierge availability request.
zero_api_whatsapp_engine.bag_checkout_flow: Generates multi-item URI containing list of items with selected metals/sizes, quantities, line totals, free delivery confirmation, and total order value.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all buttons, interactive items, inputs, and modals contain data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid=whatsapp-checkout-btn, data-testid=product-card-lum-01).
Ensure zero-API WhatsApp checkout opens wa.me/919112299902 with pre-filled encoded shopping bag summary and total price.
Persist cart items and wishlist state seamlessly in localStorage.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations and micro-interactions on mobile swipe, card tap, and bottom-sheet expansion.
Do not use transparent background on header, sticky bottom bar or modals; always use backdrop-blur glassmorphism with white opacity.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first: Prioritize viewport widths 375px to 430px, maintaining crisp 2-column grid and smooth touch interactions
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_header: Header and overlays must have backdrop-blur and semi-opaque background for high contrast legibility
